feature.name: fnm-portfolio-health-check-service-dev
feature.goal: Portfolio Health Check management for relationship managers: a Miller-column workspace that drills from a customer dashboard into portfolio summaries, versions and holdings, generates a password-protected PDF health-check report and books customer appointments.
scope: Dashboard with customer search and filters
Customer drilldown, portfolio summary, versions and version detail columns
Portfolio management: asset list, allocation check, report generation with PDF password
nonGoals: Real portfolio data or pricing APIs (mock data stands in)
